headline: Bank of Ghana Cuts Policy Interest Rate to 11% From 14%
summary: The Bank of Ghana reduced its main monetary policy rate by 300 basis points from 14% to 11%. Economists noted the move brings commercial lending rates closer to single digits.
why: The Bank of Ghana sets national interest rates to manage domestic inflation, influence borrowing costs, and stabilize the Ghanaian cedi.

impacts.name: Ghana Policy Rate
impacts.why: The central bank lowered its key policy benchmark by 3 percentage points.
